This is an open continuous announcement to fill current and future vacancies, until 07/30/2026. This is an open continuous announcement with cutoff dates.

Applications will be referred based on receipt of application and established cutoff dates as follows: 1st cutoff date: 07/17/2026 Last cutoff date: 07/24/2026 We encourage you to read this entire vacancy announcement prior to submitting your application. This position is eligible for Remote/Virtual work.

However, this position may fall under the Presidential Memorandum titled "Return to In-Person Work" which will require you to go into the office if you are located within 50 miles of a Department of Education facility in these locations: Washington, DC, Dallas, TX, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Kansas City, MO, Chicago, Il, Atlanta, GA, Philadelphia, PA, New York City, NY, and location is negotiable.

Actual salary will be based on location of selectee. Locality pay tables available at www.opm.gov . As a IT Project Manager, GS-2210-14, you will be responsible for:
· Managing and ensuring the performance of role-specific tasks: project, time, resource, and budget management, scope management, schedule management, risk management and coordination on contracts and contracts management and oversight.
· Managing the identification and coordination of technical activities of project team(s), prioritizes and facilitates technical tasks and sequence tracks of work, of IT projects/initiatives in an iterative, incremental, parallel, and time-boxed manner aligned to deliver business value.
· Managing and ensures the performance of role-specific tasks: project, time, resource, and budget management, scope management, schedule management, risk management and coordination on contracts and contracts management and oversight (in role as Contracting Officer's Technical Representative [COTR]/ Contracting Office Representative [COR]).
· Identifying and consulting on technical resource requirements for projects (e.g., analysts, developers, quality assurance), and onboard qualified resources to support project needs.
· Managing effectively and efficiently various Information Technology (IT) projects.
Minimum Qualification Requirements You may meet the minimum qualifications for the GS-14, if you possess the specialized experience.

Specialized Experience for the GS-14 One year of experience in either federal or non-federal service that is equivalent to at least a GS-13 performing two (2) out of three (3) of the following duties or work assignments: 1.

Experience leading cross-functional project teams utilizing agile methodologies and practices while identifying and managing associated risks, issues, contracts, and change requests to meet schedule, budget, and organizational policies and objectives to facilitate the delivery of incremental software or system enhancements. 2.

Experience in applying agile methods to support technical integration, system modernization, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure IT systems are compatible with architecture, cloud platforms, system interfaces, and cybersecurity requirements to reduce technical debt and improve release predictability. 3.

Experience implementing risk and issue management processes, ensuring potential blockers are identified early, escalated appropriately, resolved and aligned with established change-control processes within agile release frameworks to adhere to program timelines and deliverables.

Basic Experience Requirements You must possess IT related experience (paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training (e.g., IT certification), as appropriate) demonstrating each of the nine competencies listed below. 1. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail. 2.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services. 3.

Decision Making - Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change. 4.

Information Management - Identifies a need for and knows where or how to gather information; organizes and maintains information or information management systems. 5.

Interpersonal Skills - Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations 6.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately. 7.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. 8. Teamwork - Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals. 9.

Technical Competence – Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs) The quality of your experience will be measured by the extent to which you possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities (KSAs).

You do not need to provide separate narrative responses to these KSAs, as they will be measured by your responses to the occupational questionnaire (you may preview the occupational questionnaire by clicking the link at the end of the Evaluations section of this vacancy announcement). 1.

Skill in leading and directing people, teams and programs / projects associated with IT application development; the development of mission-critical enterprise class applications, and enterprise-wide IT projects 2.

Ability to deliver mission critical IT initiatives to meet organizational objectives using agile project management tools or techniques. 3. Ability to develop acquisition artifacts required to procure, and provide services for implementation, and operations and maintenance of an IT system and oversee vendor performance upon contract award. 4.

Ability to lead complex IT initiatives while managing changing priorities, evolving legislative or regulatory requirements and coordinating with various internal and external stakeholders.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY As a Program Manager, you will use your knowledge and experience to optimize business results and customer experience by: Managing and supporting real property projects to include supporting RPMS budgeting, auding, reporting business line and general RPMS administrative tasks.

Achieving organizational objectives by contributing information and recommendations to strategic plans and reviews; preparing and completing action plans; implementing project plans, assessing quality and customer-service standards.

Collaborating with other RPMS Branch Chiefs, ASA components, PSC and RLO to assist the RPMS Director in the accomplishment of multiple administrative and financial tasks associated with externally driven assignments and deadlines.

Enhancing RPMS and organization reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests; exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments, improve customer service and grow the business line.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Minimum Qualifications: You must have one year of specialized experience to perform successfully the duties of the position.

To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the GS-13 grade level in the Federal service performing ALL of the following: Providing leadership, management and direction to a staff who support personnel involved in real property, facilities management; Initiating, managing, planning, scheduling, and implementing construction projects of varying complexity; Coordinating and integrating activities with senior management and program managers in providing effective solutions; Providing advice to senior level management involving the adoption of new procedures and programs to improve efficiency of operations.

Documenting experience: IN DESCRIBING YOUR EXPERIENCE, PLEASE BE CLEAR AND SPECIFIC. WE WILL NOT MAKE ASSUMPTIONS REGARDING YOUR EXPERIENCE. Qualifications are based on breadth/level of experience.

In addition to describing duties performed, applicants must provide the exact dates of each period of employment (from MM/YY to MM/YY) and the number of hours worked per week if part time.

As qualification determinations cannot be made when resumes do not include the required information, failure to provide this information may result in disqualification. Applicants are encouraged to use the USAJOBS Resume Builder to develop their federal resume.

Do not copy and paste the duties, specialized experience, or occupational application questionnaire from this announcement into your resume as that will not be considered a demonstration of your qualifications for this position.

In accordance with Office of Personnel Management policy, federal employees are assumed to have gained experience by performing duties and responsibilities appropriate for their official series and grade level as described in their position description.

Experience that would not normally be part of the employee's position is creditable, however, when documented by satisfactory evidence, such as a signed memorandum from the employee's supervisor or an SF-50 or SF-52 documenting an official detail or other official assignment.

The documentation must indicate whether the duties were performed full time or, if part time, the "percentage of times" the other duties were performed. It is expected that this documentation is included in the employee's official personnel record.

In order to receive credit for experience in your resume that is not within the official series and grade level of your official position, you must provide a copy of the appropriate documentation of such experience as indicated above.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through national Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; community; student; social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to gain employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

If such experience is on a part-time basis, you must provide the average number of hours worked per week as well as the beginning and ending dates of the experience so it can be fully credited. OPM Qualification General Policies Website

The position serves as a Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Program Manager and specialist for all BARD patron-facing products in the Patron Engagement Section (PES), Patron and Network Engagement Division, National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS), Library Collections and Services Group.

As the Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Program Manager and specialist, you will: Serve as the subject matter expert in the development, implementation, and distribution of all versions of the product.

Review and analyze all BARD patron-facing products to ensure continuity in operation, consistency in delivery, high-level of accessibility, and that all patron considerations have been met. Coordinate all patron-facing customer service and technical support for all BARD products.

This includes BARD on the web, BARD Mobile for iOS, BARD Mobile for Android, BARD Mobile for Fire Devices, BARD Express, Digital Advanced (DA2) Talking Book machine, and the My Talking Book Skill. Serve as the primary liaison between the various BARD initiatives, NLS patrons, and other NLS stakeholders. Perform other duties as assigned.

Applicants must have had progressively responsible experience and training sufficient in scope and quality to furnish them with an acceptable level of the following knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the position without more than normal supervision.

Ability to interact collaboratively, providing consultation and liaison services.** Ability to provide customer service planning and management work for a program. ** Ability to communicate in writing. Ability to utilize applicable information technology. Ability to communicate effectively other than in writing.

As an IT PROJECT MANAGER some of your typical work assignments include: Leading enterprise-level IT and AI projects through full SDLC (planning, deployment, sustainment) and developing project governance frameworks, risk strategies, and performance metrics Integrating enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, cloud, and AI solutions.

Advising leadership on IT modernization, AI adoption, and policy alignment, and ensuring compliance with OMB directives, federal IT policy, and data governance standards Managing cross-functional teams and contractors delivering complex IT systems
You must meet the qualification (experience and/or education) requirements by the closing date of this announcement. To view the eligibility and qualification requirements of an IT PROJECT MANAGER, GS-2210, please visit: IT Project Manager, 2210. You must have one full year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-13 level.

Specialized experience is defined as: Experience leading enterprise portfolio management, executing enterprise-level initiatives leveraging agile methodologies, and management of cross functional teams. Experience also includes establishing governance frameworks, policies, and performance metrics for enterprise-level IT and AI projects.

Information Technology Infrastructure Library version 4 (ITIL v.4) Foundation certification preferred.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills, and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including any volunteer experience.

Please do not cut and paste the "Duties" section, specialized experience statement, or occupational assessment questionnaire from this announcement into your resume, as this will not be considered a demonstration of your qualifications for this position.

Über Recare
Als eines der führenden deutschen HealthTech-Unternehmen gestalten wir das Entlassmanagement neu – technologiegetrieben, patientenzentriert und frei von Bürokratie.

Neben unserer marktführenden SaaS-Plattform entwickeln wir KI-Lösungen, die Prozesse in Kliniken und bei Nachversorgern radikal vereinfachen, Fachkräfte entlasten und den Fokus zurück auf die Patientinnen und Patienten legen.

Bereits heute vernetzen wir zwei Drittel aller deutschen Krankenhäuser mit über 650 Rehakliniken und 25.000 Pflege- und Homecare-Anbietern. Mit aktuell rund 100 Mitarbeitenden wachsen wir weiter – und suchen Menschen mit Haltung, die das Gesundheitssystem mit uns verbessern wollen.
Das erwartet dich als unser Senior Implementation Manager (Hospital) (m/w/d):
Arbeit mit Purpose – deine Tätigkeit hat positiven Einfluss auf Patientinnen und Patienten, ihre Angehörigen und medizinische Fachkräfte im Gesundheitswesen.
Unternehmenskultur – wir setzen auf flache Hierarchien, die eine hohe Performance und eine starke Teamdynamik fördern. Wir pflegen einen Umgang, der von gegenseitigem Respekt, Loyalität und Anerkennung geprägt ist, und streben gemeinsam nach unseren Zielen und erwarten das Gleiche von dir.
Flexibilität – möchtest du dein Kind aus der Kita abholen? Machst du gerne Sport in der Mittagspause? Wir unterstützen dich dabei. Wir sind ein Remote-freundliches Unternehmen, bei dem du flexible Arbeitszeiten hast. Nach Absprache kannst du gerne auch Workations machen.
Edenred-Karte – die du nach deinen Bedürfnissen nutzen kannst.
Zusatz-Urlaubstag – damit du deinen Geburtstag mit deinen Liebsten feiern kannst, hast du ihn frei.
Deine Rolle als Senior Implementation Manager (Hospital) (m/w/d):
Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere AI-Lösungen dort ankommen, wo sie den größten Unterschied machen: im Klinikalltag. Als Senior Implementation Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für komplexe Kundenrollouts und steuerst unsere größten und strategisch wichtigsten Implementierungsprojekte – von der ersten Planung bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live und darüber hinaus.
Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Klinik-Kunden und den internen Recare-Teams. Mit deiner Erfahrung im Krankenhausumfeld schaffst du Vertrauen auf Augenhöhe, navigierst komplexe Stakeholder-Strukturen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Lösungen nachhaltig im klinischen Alltag verankert werden.
Du steuerst komplexe End-to-End-Rollouts unserer Recare AI Suite in Krankenhäusern – von der Discovery-Phase über Planung und Umsetzung bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live und der Übergabe in den Regelbetrieb.
Als verantwortliche Person für die Umsetzung koordinierst du alle relevanten Stakeholder auf Kundenseite und intern: von Klinikleitung und IT über medizinische Fachbereiche bis hin zu unseren Teams aus Clinical Solution Consulting, Interoperability, Customer Success und Product.
Du entwickelst robuste Rollout-Pläne, steuerst Abhängigkeiten, moderierst Entscheidungen und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte auch bei hoher Komplexität erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.
Du führst unsere Kunden durch Veränderungsprozesse und stellst sicher, dass Enablement, Trainings und die Hypercare-Phase optimal vorbereitet und umgesetzt werden.
Du behältst den Blick für Skalierbarkeit: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Herausforderungen, verbesserst unsere Prozesse und hilfst dabei, unsere Implementierungsmethodik kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Bei strategisch wichtigen Großkunden und Multi-Site-Rollouts übernimmst du eine führende Rolle und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Product und Customer Success zusammen.
So stellen wir uns dich als unseren Senior Implementation Manager (Hospital) (m/w/d) vor:
Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Implementierung, Customer Delivery, Professional Services oder Projektmanagement mit – idealerweise im SaaS- oder HealthTech-Umfeld.
Erfahrung im Krankenhausumfeld ist für diese Rolle ein Muss . Du kennst die Strukturen, Entscheidungswege und Herausforderungen in Kliniken und kannst dich sicher zwischen unterschiedlichen Perspektiven bewegen.
Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Prozess- und Methodenkompetenz mit und entwickelst Standards, Templates und Qualitätsprozesse weiter, um Implementierungen skalierbar zu machen.
Du bist erfahren im Stakeholder-Management und kommunizierst souverän auf allen Ebenen – von Klinikgeschäftsführung und ärztlicher Leitung bis hin zu IT-Teams und operativen Anwendern. Auch in schwierigen Situationen bewahrst du Ruhe, schaffst Klarheit und bringst Entscheidungen voran.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und pragmatisch – auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten – und bringst ein AI-native Mindset mit bzw. die Lernbereitschaft, KI als selbstverständliches Arbeitsmittel in deine Arbeit zu integrieren.
Du bist bereit, regelmäßig bei unseren Kunden vor Ort zu sein – insbesondere bei wichtigen Projektphasen wie Discovery, Workshops und Go-Lives (ca. 40 % Reisetätigkeit).
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1/C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B2) runden dein Profil ab.

Grundverständnis für AI-Governance und sichere AI-Prozesse (z. B. Change Control, Incident Playbooks, HITL-Guardrails)
Erfahrung mit mehreren parallelen Kundenprojekten in einem dynamischen Scale-up-Umfeld

Clēnera is a tier-one developer and independent power producer located in Boise, Idaho, and is the U.S. subsidiary of Enlight Renewable Energy (Nasdaq: ENLT ). We develop, finance, construct, own, and operate utility-scale solar and energy storage facilities throughout the United States.

In its 2025 analysis of solar independent power producers, S&P Global ranked Clēnera as a top ten U.S. owner of planned installations in the next five years. Clēnera has over 1.9 GW of solar and 5.1 GWh of storage in operations or construction, and a development pipeline totaling 17.8 GW of solar and 51.1 GWh of storage across 23 states.

Our company culture is at the core of everything we do, so you’ll regularly find Caring, Committed, and Courageous individuals who value respectful, cross-functional collaboration with partners internally and externally. With our tremendous portfolio growth, we are increasing our headcount to meet the demands of the business.

Are you ready to change the world with us? ABOUT THE ROLE The HV & Commissioning Project Manager represents the Owner (IPP) and leads all high-voltage (HV), protection & controls (P&C), SCADA/communications, testing, and commissioning activities for utility-scale solar and energy storage assets.

This role owns cost, schedule, scope, quality, and risk for the HV build and commissioning phases from pre-functional checks through energization, interconnection testing, COD, and turnover to Operations.

Functions as the primary interface with utilities, Owner’s engineers, EPCs, testing/commissioning vendors, and internal stakeholders, ensuring systems are safe, compliant, utility-approved, and reliable for long-term operations.

WHAT YOU'LL DO Own end-to-end HV and site wide commissioning project planning and control, establishing the WBS, baseline schedule, cash flow forecasts, procurement milestones, and resource plans. Drive weekly schedule reviews, recovery planning, and critical path management with EPC and site leadership.

Lead HV and site wide commissioning cost management and forecasting, including monthly EAC/EVA updates, change order pricing validation, contingency management, pay application review/approval, and alignment of financial reporting with Project Controls and Finance.

Direct contract administration, ensuring scope clarity, deliverable compliance, and change management discipline; draft, negotiate, and recommend change orders and claims with clear schedule/cost impact analyses.

Coordinate cross-functional execution to ensure design completeness, permitting compliance, interconnection readiness, and QA/QC adherence. Execute risk management throughout the lifecycle, maintaining the risk register, quantifying impacts, implementing mitigations, and escalating strategic risks to senior leadership with recommended actions.

Drive site safety culture and compliance, integrating HSSE requirements into schedules and work plans and ensuring EPC adherence to safety KPIs and incident reporting.

Manage external stakeholder relationships, including utilities, AHJs, landowners, third party inspectors, and lenders’ engineers, ensuring timely reviews, approvals, and alignment on critical path items.

Produce executive ready reports and presentations, summarizing progress, risks, cash flow, and forecasted outcomes for internal leadership and, when applicable, board-level review. Mentor and guide other members of the project team, delegating workstreams, providing technical direction, and building execution discipline across the project team.

Lead lessons learned and continuous improvement, capturing insights during closeout and feeding back process and contract improvement recommendations to Construction leadership. Collaborate with individual departments, as well as cross-functionally with other departments within the organization.

Maintain organizational excellence in terms of project timelines and deliverables. Demonstrates the Clēnera Core Values of Caring, Committed, and Courageous. Other duties as assigned. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS Education: Bachelor’s degree in construction management, electrical engineering, , business, or related field experience.

Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in HV construction and commissioning project management. Minimum of 2 years of experience executing utility-scale renewable energy projects. Technology: Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, and an ability to learn company-specific software programs, tools, processes, and machines.

Skills/Attributes: Strong understanding of schedule and cost controls, including critical path analysis, recovery planning, earned value, EAC forecasting, and cash flow management.

Strong EPC contract administration and negotiation skills, capable of structuring clear change orders, resolving claims, and driving accountability to contractual obligations. Technical fluency in utility scale HV, construction, including civil works, MV/HV systems, SCADA, protection/controls, energy storage technology and commissioning sequences.

Adept at identifying systemic and emergent risks, quantifying impacts, and implementing mitigation actions that protect COD and budget objectives. Ability to build trust and effectively coordinate with utilities, AHJs, inspectors, lenders’ engineers, and EPC executives to clear critical path issues.

Clear, persuasive communication, producing concise, decision ready reporting for senior leadership and guiding the project team toward shared outcomes. Demonstrated ability to lead highly effective teams, both internally and externally.

# Chef de projet TIC / Projets de numérisation #
## Office de l'informatique | 60-100 % | Coire ##
Es-tu prêt à participer au développement de la transformation numérique ? En tant que centre de services et de compétences TIC de l'administration cantonale des Grisons, nous soutenons nos clients internes avec une infrastructure de base sécurisée et des applications avancées. Ensemble avec toi, nous faisons progresser la transformation numérique du canton des Grisons.
Nous, en tant que **Office de l'informatique**, recherchons dès maintenant ou selon accord un/une chef de projet TIC pour les projets de numérisation.
Votre domaine de responsabilités
* Vous agissez en tant que chef de projet TIC et conduisez des projets de numérisation de l'initialisation à la réussite finale
* Vous rédigez des documentations de projet, analyses, rapports et présentations pour différents groupes cibles
* Vous développez des solutions numériques en tenant compte de l'architecture existante d'e-gouvernement, de sécurité et d'intégration
* Vous soutenez les achats et surveillez les progrès du projet, les risques, la qualité et les coûts
* Vous soutenez les chefs de projet dans les services dans le cadre de notre communauté de gestion de projet / analyse métier
Ce que nous attendons de vous
* Une formation ou une formation continue en informatique, informatique de gestion ou dans un domaine comparable
* Une expérience professionnelle de plusieurs années en tant que chef de projet TIC, idéalement complétée par une formation/certification dans le domaine HERMES, IPMA ou PMI
* Une expérience en analyse métier et gestion des exigences
* Une bonne communication et une manière de travailler structurée et orientée équipe
* De bonnes connaissances de l'allemand à l'oral et à l'écrit

Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. La Direction des soins incarne l-autorité en matière de soins. Elle a pour mission de garantir la qualité et la sécurité des soins au sein de l'établissement. A ce titre, la Direction des soins a droit de regard sur l-ensemble des activités des soins (infirmiers, infirmières et différents corps professionnels de santé).

Pour remplir sa mission, elle s-appuie sur trois pôles d'expertises : qualité, durabilité et innovation digitale ; expertise clinique et pratiques professionnelles ; management et transformation.
## Description du poste ##
La direction des soins est à la recherche de son ou sa future responsable diététicienne pour manager et accompagner les équipes sur le site de Cluse-Roseraie dans leurs prestations dans différents départements médicaux. La patientèle peut être adulte comme pédiatrique notamment dans le domaine des soins aigus ainsi que pour l-enseignement thérapeutique au décours de la maladie chronique.
Vous dirigez une équipe d-environ 30 collaborateurs et collaboratrices. Vous organisez, coordonnez et supervisez leurs activités et prévoyez toute action nécessaire de développement des compétences individuelles comme collectives. Vous garantissez une circulation optimale des informations, qu-elle soit ascendante, descendante et/ ou transversale. Vous développez un climat de confiance dans l-équipe nécessaire au bien vivre et travailler ensemble dans le respect des valeurs institutionnelles.
Vous savez donner le cap et accompagner vos équipes pour atteindre des objectifs communs. Vous déclinez les axes stratégiques de votre métier en objectifs réalisables par l-équipe tout en veillant à la contribution individuelle de chaque membre.
En qualité de responsable d-équipe, vous êtes garante ou garant de la qualité des soins nutritionnels et promouvez toute mesure visant à optimiser et à améliorer les prestations offertes à la patientèle. Vous disposez d-indicateurs pour conduire l-amélioration continue de la qualité. Vous contribuez également au développement de nouvelles pratiques.
Votre esprit collaboratif vous permet de soutenir et développer l-interdisciplinarité entre tous les professionnelles et professionnels de la santé agissant sur la prise en charge des patientes et patients.
Vous gérez aisément la bonne allocation des ressources comme du matériel pour répondre aux besoins en soins des patients et patientes dans le cadre du budget alloué. Vous exercez également un rôle de référente ou référent pour les systèmes tarifaires en lien avec la profession
Selon les besoins, vous êtes amené ou amenée à recruter de nouvelles collaboratrices et collaborateurs et veillez au développement de leur expertise dans les champs de spécialité de chaque secteur tout en veillant à la polyvalence nécessaire des compétences

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bachelor HES en nutrition et diététique ou d'un titre jugé équivalent, reconnu par la Croix-Rouge suisse.
Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée en management, acquise au travers d'au moins cinq années de pratique dans le domaine hospitalier. Une formation en management, telle qu'un CAS en management des institutions de santé, constitue un atout.
Dotée ou doté d'excellentes qualités relationnelles, vous faites preuve d'entregent et d'une communication positive. Vous savez fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs et instaurer un climat de collaboration propice au bon fonctionnement du service.
Ouvert ou ouverte au changement, vous êtes capable d'accompagner les évolutions de votre environnement professionnel avec pragmatisme. Vous savez également prendre du recul sur vos pratiques managériales afin de les faire évoluer de manière continue.
Vous êtes une personne reconnue pour votre sens de l'organisation, votre flexibilité et votre capacité à gérer les priorités, vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement où les activités sont variées et transversales.
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques courants et possédez une excellente maîtrise de la langue française.

Wir sind ein gesundes, familiengeführtes KMU und entwickeln, produzieren und unterhalten hochwertige, innovative Produkte. Unser Hauptsitz befindet sich in Stäfa (Zürich), die Produktion und Montage aller Instrumente findet in Feuerthalen (Grenze zu Schaffhausen) statt.

Du leitest Entwicklungsprojekte in unterschiedlicher Grösse von Kundenanforderungen bis zur Serienreife in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem RnD Team und einem Netzwerk an externen Dienstleistern \- dabei trägst du die Kosten\- und Terminverantwortung
Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden, Lieferanten und Entwicklungspartnern im In\- und Ausland
Du erarbeitest technische Konzepte und arbeitest aktiv in der Entwicklung und bei Tests mit

s.h: DEIN PROFIL? DU ÜBERZEUGST UNS MIT
s.t:
Deiner Berufserfahrung in der Produktentwicklung oder Projektleitung aus einem entwicklungsnahen Bereich, idealerweise aus einem regulierten Umfeld (z.B. GAMP, IVD, MDR)
Einer abgeschlossenen höheren Ausbildung (FH / ETH) in Ingenieurwissenschaften (z.B. Elektrotechnik)
Deinen Superkräften: Du kombinierst deine Kreativität mit technischem Wissen und behältst auch bei komplexen Projekten den Überblick
Deinen sehr guten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch (mind. Level B2\) und deiner Umsetzungsstärke

Ein attraktives Paket: nebst einer 41h Woche, mehreren Brückentagen und mind. 5 Wochen Ferien, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, bezahlten Pausen, bieten wir vieles mehr (siehe unter: "Arbeiten bei MBV")
Du hast die Möglichkeit eine Produktentwicklung von der ersten Idee bis zur Serienproduktion zu verantworten und das in einer kleinen Firma mit schlanken Führungsstrukturen, bei der du mit deiner Initiative etwas bewegt kannst
Ein starkes Team: Werde Teil eines motivierten, aktiven und hilfsbereiten Teams in einem innovationsfreudigen Umfeld
Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Platz für deine Ideen und einen fachspezifischen Austausch

## Description ##
### **Your Purpose** ###
As a Casino Manager onboard our cruise line, you will be responsible for directing the overall casino and gaming operations, creating a dynamic and entertaining environment that engages and retains guest attention.

Your leadership will set the standard for excellence in gaming, as you oversee the strategic planning, implementation, and execution of all gaming activities. You will ensure the smooth operation of the casino, ensuring that every guest enjoys an exceptional experience, while maintaining high standards of safety, compliance, and integrity.

Your role will include managing and motivating a team, creating promotional activities, and continuously striving to deliver an unparalleled entertainment experience. Your efforts will directly contribute to the overall success of the onboard experience, ensuring guests return for more.

As Casino Manager, your impact goes far beyond overseeing gaming operations; you will be the heartbeat of the casino, making it a central and attractive part of our cruise experience.

You will have the opportunity to influence guest satisfaction by providing a world-class gaming environment and creating a memorable experience for guests, driving revenue and fostering long-term guest loyalty.

The leadership and management you provide will elevate your team-s performance, ensuring they exceed expectations and contribute to a high-energy, customer-focused casino atmosphere. Your decisions will drive the casino-s success, ensuring a balance between profitability, guest satisfaction, and regulatory compliance.
### **Your Journey So Far** ###

s.h: To be successful in this role, you have
s.t:
Proven experience as a Casino Manager or in a managerial role in a land-based casino or cruise line.
A track record of consistently high-performance ratings and guest satisfaction in the casino industry.
Strong background in casino operations, including gaming rules and regulations, guest relations, and staff management.
Demonstrated ability to drive business growth, generate revenue, and foster a positive team culture.
Previous experience in managing a team of diverse staff members, providing coaching, development, and performance feedback.
Solid understanding of gaming trends, casino promotions, and how to create an exciting atmosphere that attracts guests.
### **Your Essentials** ###
Fluent in English (both spoken and written), with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Relevant qualifications in Casino Management or a related field, including certifications in gaming operations or supervision.
Proven experience in a managerial role within a casino, cruise line, or hospitality industry with demonstrated results.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage, inspire, and motivate a team of casino staff.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, ensuring operations run smoothly at all times.
A customer-centric attitude, focused on providing exceptional service to all guests.
In-depth knowledge of casino games, operations, and compliance with relevant gaming regulations and company policies.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
## Our commitment ##
We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.
Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

The Supervisory Program Manager (PM) Registered Nurse (RN) of Nursing Education & Research (NEaR) reports directly to the Associate Nurse Executive, NEaR. In collaboration with the ANE, the Supervisory PM assumes accountability for the operation of the NEaR section/programs.

The Supervisory PM is also responsible for contributing to the establishment and implementation of evidence-based nursing standards of practice. The Supervisory PM creates a positive work environment and promotes a culturally diverse workforce in which the values and needs of all individuals are respected.

The Supervisory PM NEaR assumes the following major duties and responsibilities: 1. Assists with the organizational vision that integrates program goals, strategic priorities, core values, and other factors for NEaR. 2. Completesrecurring reports, action items and performance evaluations in a timely manner. 3.

Responsible for nursing education staff scheduling and certifying timecards for nursing education time. 4. Develop and evaluate performance evaluations of NEaR staff. 5.

Analyze units' operations, conduct all aspects of personnel management to include recruitment, performance management, training, compensation oversight, and labor relations issues. 6. Attends all mandatory training, seeks opportunities for improvement and demonstrates creative thinking. 7. Assigns work to subordinates based on priorities. 8.

Recommends and/or takes disciplinary action where appropriate. 9. Organize and lead staff meetings and huddles. 10. Develop, organize, implement, and/or maintain orientation and competenciesfor NEaR employees. 11.

Collaborates with Unit Practice Councils (UPCs) to implement changes/processesin the section related to feedback from the All-Employee Survey (AES). 12. Actively participates in and support of Shared Governance and Relationship Based Care. 13.

Participatesin and supports High Reliability Organization (HRO) principles, system redesign projects and Lean Six Sigma thinking to positively impact the service and organization. 14. Participates on service and medical center committees and task forcesto improve nursing practice and patient care. 15.

Proactively makesleadership choicesto prioritize Veteran-Centered needs, operate within allocated resources and takes the initiative to find solutions. 16. Works collaboratively with Nurse Managers to ensure coverage and to coordinate project and resources. 17.

Maintains knowledge and understanding of The Joint Commission (TJC) requirements and ensures compliance with VHA, Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) standards, and other accrediting organizations. 18.

Maintain knowledge of specific performance results and metrics such as Strategic Analytics for Improvement Learning (SAIL), Nurse Sensitive Indicators (NDNQI) and TJC. 19. Provide leadership, organization, and coordination of employees and resources to meet patient needs. 20.

Serve as a resource and/or mentor to new personnel, providers, and students. 21. In collaboration with the ANE NEaR, oversight of VA-Student Training Experience Program (VA-STEP), the Employee Incentive Scholarship Program (EISP), National Nursing Education Initiative (NNEI), VA National Employee Education Program (VANEEP) for Nursing Service. 22.

Executesin collaboration with the ANE NEaR the Nursing Service Travel and Tuition and Veterans Health Education & Information (VHEI) Program operating budget, prepares budget requests with justifications, and aligns resources to deliver sustained value to Veterans. 23. Performs other duties as assigned.

VA offers a comprehensive total rewards package: VA Nurse Total Rewards Pay: Competitive salary, regular salary increases, potential for performance awards Paid Time Off: 50 days of paid time off per year (26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year) Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Licensure: 1 full and unrestricted license from any US State or territory Work Schedule: Full Time, 0730-1600 Compressed/Flexible: N/A Telework: N/A Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: N/A
Basic Requirements: English Language Proficiency. In accordance with 38 U.S.C. 7403(f), no person shall serve in direct patient care positions unless they are proficient in basic written and spoken English.

Graduate of a school of professional nursing approved by the appropriate accrediting agency and accredited by one of the following accrediting bodies at the time the program was completed by the applicant: The Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN) or The Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE); OR Individuals attending a master's level bridge program in nursing who have completed coursework equivalent to a bachelor's level degree in Nursing may have opportunity to become registered as a nurse with a state licensing board prior to completion of the bridge program.

Upon achievement of a State license, the individual may be appointed on temporary basis and later converted to a permanent appointment upon successful completion and graduation from the bridge program.

(Reference VA Handbook 5005, Appendix G6); OR In cases of graduates of foreign schools of professional nursing, possession of a current, full, active, and unrestricted registration will meet the requirement for graduation from an approved school of professional nursing to warrant an appointment as a Nurse who has completed an associated degree/entry level Nursing education program.

Credit for foreign nursing education higher that associate degree/entry level requires a formal degree equivalency validation from a recognized equivalency evaluation accepted by VA such as International Consultants of Delaware (ICD).

Current, full, active, and unrestricted registration as a graduate professional nurse in a State, Territory or Commonwealth (i.e., Puerto Rico) of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

Graduate Nurse Technician (GNT) Exception: Candidates who otherwise meet the basic education requirements, but do not possess the required licensure, may be appointed at the entry step of the grade and level applicable to the completed nursing education as a GNT on a 120-day temporary appointment while actively pursuing licensure (may be extended up to two years on a case-by-case-basis.) NOTE: Grandfathering Provision - All persons currently employed in VHA in 0610 series and performing the duties as described in the qualification standard on the effective date of the standard (1/29/2024) are considered to have met all qualification requirements for the grade held including positive education and licensure/certification.

Grade Determinations: The following Scope, Education and Dimension criteria must be met in determining the grade assignment of candidates, and if appropriate, the level within a grade.

The Dimension requirements (Practice, Veteran/Patient Driven Care, Leadership, Professional Development and Evidence-Based Practice/Research) are detailed for each grade and level within the online assessment: https://apply.usastaffing.gov/ViewQuestionnaire/13046631.

Grade/Level Scope Education Nurse I, Level I Delivers fundamental, knowledge-based care to assigned clients while developing technical competencies. An Associate Degree (ADN) or Diploma in Nursing, with no additional professional nursing required.

Nurse I, Level II Demonstrates integration of biopsychosocial concepts, cognitive skills and technically competent practice in providing care to clients with basic or complex.

An ADN or Diploma in Nursing AND 1 year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 1 ;OR a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) with no additional professional nursing experience required. Nurse I, Level III Demonstrates proficiency in practice based on conscious and deliberate planning.

Self-directed in goal setting for managing complex client situations.

An ADN or Diploma in Nursing AND 2 years of professional nursing experience in which one year is equivalent to Nurse I, Level 2; OR a BSN and 1 year of professional nursing experience equivalent to the Nurse I, Level 2; OR a Master's degree in nursing (MSN) and no additional professional nursing experience; OR a Master's degree in a *related field with a BSN and no additional professional nursing experience.

Nurse II Demonstrates leadership in delivering and improving holistic care through collaborative strategies with others.

A BSN with 2 years of professional nursing equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR an MSN with one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR a Master's degree in a *related field with a BSN and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR a Doctoral degree in Nursing with no professional nursing experience; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN with no additional professional nursing experience.

Nurse III Executes position responsibilities that demonstrate leadership, experience and creative approaches to management of complex client care beyond the immediate practice setting.

MSN and 2 years of specialized nursing experience, one of which is equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Master's degree in *related field with BSN and two years of specialized nursing experience, one of which is equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Doctoral degree in Nursing with and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III. *Note: Foreign education programs/degrees are not creditable as related degrees.

Preferred Experience: MSN or other related healthcare degree preferred. At least 3-5 years of current full-time employment as an RN. Current management or charge nurse experience.

Strong leadership, fiscal, and operations management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with all disciplines, management, and staff from all points of entry. Demonstrate organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead a team, prioritize tasks, and see projects through from inception to completion.

Experience with developing presentations and written communication. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to quickly analyze problems, determine appropriate level of intervention, and develop and apply effective solution.

Strong interpersonal skills for effective information exchange and problem solving with all levels of management and staff, consultants, and outside agencies. Ability to work independently and complete tasks in a timely manner.

Experience with Employee Incentive Scholarship Program (EISP), Veteran Affairs National Education for Employees Program (VANEEP), Veteran Affairs Student Trainee Experience Program (VA-STEP). Experience with formulating, submitting, and monitoring budgets. Demonstrated experience in program planning and management.

The Agile Delivery Manager (ADM) is accountable for delivering business value across one or more agile teams, specifically in support of the organization’s digital transformation.

Acting as a servant leader and connector between strategic intent and operational execution, the ADM sits at the bridge point between the product/feature layer (Product Owners, Business Analysts, Business Owners) and the delivery layer (Engineering Managers, Developers, QA, and the Scrum Masters who own team-level performance).

The ADM ensures that delivery aligns with product roadmaps, value streams, and enterprise priorities.
This role is not about managing tasks—it’s about enabling flow, clarity, and measurable outcomes that advance the organization’s customer and business goals. The ADM owns the health and predictability of the Program Increment (PI): making sure it is planned well, tracked honestly, and delivered against — while escalating risks and dependencies before they become blockers. .

s.h: The role is responsible for the following results
s.t:
Delivery Flow and Value
Consistently leveraging lean and agile practices to achieve outcomes, not just complete output.
Orchestrate planning and coordination activities across multiple teams, including PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums and cross-team synchronization, and protecting the teams against interference and over commitment, to sustain focus and health velocity.
Advise Product Owners and Business Analysts in backlog management and sequencing to ensure clear cross-team prioritization.
Monitor flow and delivery health metrics (predictability, throughput, cycle time, PI objective achievement) and share them with teams to celebrate progress and surface improvement opportunities
Use performance and progress data to increase transparency and predictability in meeting commitments to the business.
Facilitate the adoption and evolution of agile practices to continuously improve how the organization produces high quality and high value outcomes.
Align teams with strategic goals through transparent sequencing of work, clear identification of cross-team dependencies; own the identification, tracking, and mitigation of delivery risks and issues, ensuring timely resolution or escalation.
Facilitate scaled/cross-team agile events (e.g., PI Planning, System Demo, Inspect & Adapt, Scrum of Scrums) so they are productive and time-boxed, setting a consistent standard of effectiveness across teams. Team-level ceremonies remain owned by Scrum Masters. Ensure delivery standards and definitions of done are applied consistently across the teams.
Enablement & Coaching
Coach Scrum Masters, Business Owners, Product Owners and Business Analysts to communicated in terms of value delivered rather than requirement fulfillment.
Guide continuous improvement through retrospectives, delivery health checks, and root-cause analysis at the multi-team and PI Levels
Build agile maturity through mentoring, modeling psychological safety, and reenforcing learning cycles.
Stakeholder Engagement
Translate delivery progress into business impact, reporting what value was realized, not just completed.
Own upward and outward communication of delivery status, risks, and PI outcomes to executives, business owners, the Governance & Transformation Lead, and technology leadership.
Ensure the “voice of delivery” is represented in strategic planning and portfolio discussions.

PI predictability (planned vs. delivered PI objectives) across teams in scope.
Flow metrics trend (cycle time, throughput, work-in-progress) shared and improving over time.
Time-to-resolution on escalated risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies.
Stakeholder-reported clarity and trust in delivery commitments (Business Owners, executive sponsors).
Team-reported psychological safety and agile maturity progression.

Im Interesse von Unternehmen und Bevölkerung identifizieren wir volkswirtschaftlichen Handlungsbedarf und leisten wirkungsvolle Beiträge, um den Wirtschaftsstandort Zürich nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Unsere Kernleistungen zielen darauf ab, optimale wirtschaftliche Rahmenbedingungen zu schaffen und gleichzeitig geltendes Recht im Sinne des Gesetzgebers umzusetzen.
Der Bereich Standortförderung stärkt den Wirtschafts-, Forschungs- und Innovationsstandort Zürich. Wir vernetzen Akteurinnen und Akteure aus Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und Politik, begleiten Unternehmensansiedlungen und setzen wichtige Impulse für eine zukunftsfähige Standortentwicklung.
Im Kontext zunehmender hybrider Bedrohungen bauen Sie innerhalb der Standortförderung den Kompetenzbereich -Resilienz und Sicherheit- mit auf und stärken die Innovations- und Forschungskraft des Kantons Zürich.
